refs.role: Moravel fictional model identity, long 8-inch shorts and styling

prompt: Create ONE new photorealistic sportswear photograph of the SAME fictional red-haired freckled adult woman from input1, in the SAME long black high-waisted 8-inch bike shorts ending just above knees, rear construction input2. Slate sleeveless tank tucked above waistband and entirely plain black trainers with dark soles. New rear three-quarter brisk walking stride on blue track, head turned subtly in profile, hard side sun and long shadows. Show entire body and garment, new camera viewpoint and pose. Tiny tonal MORAVEL in condensed uppercase sans at rear waistband only. No other text/logos. REQUIRED CANVAS: EXACT 4:5 aspect ratio, 1122 pixels wide by 1402 pixels tall, or larger 4:5 such as 2048x2560. Compose on a wider 4:5 frame, not a tall 3:4 frame. Add horizontal track space around subject. No border; full hair and shoes.

qa.notes: Visually inspected generation: garment silhouette, colour family, view, framing and scene; model identity and anatomy where applicable. Native dimensions independently verified at installation.
qa.colorCheck: Visual colour-family comparison; hex values are design targets.
